homelabDetails.description: My personal homelab is a complete ecosystem for development, automation, self-hosting, and smart-home orchestration. It runs on a mix of Proxmox and Docker hosts, a dedicated TrueNAS storage server, and a Raspberry Pi fleet — all behind an OPNsense firewall on a full 2.5G UniFi network and securely published through Cloudflare Zero Trust. This environment powers my daily development workflows, local AI experiments, automation pipelines, 3D-printing operations, and shared family services.
specs: **Compute & Virtualization:** Proxmox on a Ryzen 7 mini-PC alongside dual ThinkCentre M910q Docker hosts
**Storage:** Custom-built TrueNAS Core server with RAID-backed media and backups
**Dev & AI:** Mac Mini M4 dedicated to development and local LLM workloads
**Edge Compute:** Raspberry Pi 4 and Pi 5 fleet for utility and controller nodes
**Networking:** OPNsense firewall with a full 2.5G UniFi stack — PoE switching and WiFi 7
**Secure Access:** Cloudflare Zero Trust tunnels — internal services with no inbound ports
**Self-Hosted Services:** 15+ containerized apps spanning automation, media, and dashboards
**Home Automation:** Home Assistant with Zigbee and Frigate camera AI
**3D Printing:** Elegoo Centauri Carbon 2 and Creality Hi with automated monitoring
